name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: Apple's iCloud and Apple Pay outage on 17 Nov falls within 48h; no new major outage found on 18 Nov
state: Downdetector showed US reports for Apple Pay peaking at 2,146 and iCloud at 1,793 on the evening of 17 Nov, after an outage Apple blamed on an internal update (Khaleej Times). That follows Microsoft's outage of Outlook, Teams and Copilot in 74 countries from 12 Nov, which lasted over 24 hours (Al Jazeera, 13 Nov). No new major outage was found on 18 Nov. A payments-linked outage within 48h keeps Watch.
for_you: Keep a backup payment method when travelling or shopping; outages usually clear within hours.
rubric_hit: Payments-linked cloud outage > 2h within 48h (Apple Pay, 17 Nov) = Watch

sources.title: Khaleej Times — Thousands of US users report Apple iCloud, Pay outages
Al Jazeera — Microsoft hit by global outages: what happened and why?

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
